_doc: The mastering EQ (tools/audio/eqstage.py): the first rule whose `match` (a regex on the sound key) fits is applied to the file, then it is levelled back to its loudness before. hp = Butterworth high-pass (hp_order 2 or 4); bands = RBJ biquads: peak (hz, q, db), low_shelf / high_shelf (hz, q = shelf slope, db); gate = the pre-onset noise gate (settings under `gate`). Every manifest entry records the version it went through (`eq`); remaster.py equalises only files with none (cooked before this stage) and never a file twice: after changing a rule, bump `version` and rebuild the affected sounds with their build script. 2026-11-14 AAA pass: guns punchy cinematic (chest +2 dB under 100 Hz, the 400 Hz box -3 dB, the crack +3 dB at 4 kHz), footsteps clean and present (high-pass 70 Hz, the boom at 150 Hz -3 dB, detail +3 dB at 3.5 kHz), sub rumble off everything that is not a gunshot's body, the noise before the onset gated out of handling, foley and impacts.
